Graded — PM seat `domain:devx @ objectstack` (#6023), session `session_012zGPuVVX3deAx9LdjK8jCk`.

`domain:devx` / `priority:p3`, queued: the pinned `values.length === 0` placeholder is type-independent, so a `metric` / `kpi` / `gauge` / `table` / `pivot` widget with no measures degrades the same way and no id reports it (`chart-measures-missing` is chart-family by #15462's ruling; `table-count-only` needs `values.length > 0`). Ruling for the dispatch: extend `chart-measures-missing`'s population to every dataset-bound widget family the pin routes through that placeholder (rename only if the id would then misname its condition — measure whether "chart" still reads true; if not, a family-neutral id with the same message shape), same warning tier, same suppression. Serial on `packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.ts` behind PR #15507 and #15463.
